{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVdzeZs8AAAABbjRtgw", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bpi2wzhFHN-c", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bpi2w", "number": 11, "title": "Use the actual Animasa Hatsune Miku (あにまさ式ミク) in the MotionBricks MMD demo", "body": "## Goal / correction to #9

**Use the actual あにまさ式初音ミク (Animasa Hatsune Miku) character in the MotionBricks + MMD demo.** The user specifically requested Animasa Miku in #9, but implementation PR #10 substituted CG-CA Uka. **Uka is not an acceptable substitute for this task.** Make the existing `SOMA / MMD` selector offer **SOMA / MMD (Animasa Miku)**; Uka may remain as an additional, explicitly named optional model if useful, but **must not be used to claim Animasa support is complete**.

The existing MotionBricks inference, SOMA motion playback, SOMA→MMD retargeting, MMD toon/outline shaders, and MMD rigid-body physics are the foundation; don't replace generated motion with VMD.

## Exact asset to target

- Original/historical Three.js MMD example: `examples/models/mmd/miku/miku_v2.pmd` at [mrdoob/three.js r87](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r87/examples/models/mmd/miku/miku_v2.pmd).
- The prior investigation in [docs/mmd.md](https://github.com/takahirox/three-motionbricks/blob/main/docs/mmd.md#animasa-miku-provenance-and-redistribution-blocker) identifies the PMD header as a physics-enabled Hatsune Miku PolyMo model version 2.3 with credit to **あにまさ氏**. Confirm its provenance and source files before conversion.
- Historical reference: [takahirox/MMDLoader-app](https://github.com/takahirox/MMDLoader-app/blob/master/app_interactive.html), which used this asset.
- Implementation references: [takahirox/mmd-gltf](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf), [takahirox/three-mmd-loader](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader), and #9 / PR #10.

## Tasks

- [ ] Locate the exact historical Animasa Miku PMD and all required texture/material/rig/physics resources, pin revision/hashes, and document provenance.
- [ ] **Resolve rights for the model**: inspect the complete original author/distributor terms and Crypton/Piapro guidelines or obtain explicit permission for conversion, derivative GLB, and public GitHub Pages redistribution. Permission previously given for `takahirox/mmd-gltf` **code** does not grant permission over third-party Miku character/model assets. If public redistribution cannot be established, **report the precise blocker and request the required rights/asset from the user; do not silently replace Miku with Uka or publish an unlicensed GLB**. A compliant local-only/user-supplied asset conversion workflow may be offered as an interim solution, clearly labeled as such.
- [ ] Implement a deterministic **offline PMD → glTF/GLB conversion** (either a validated PMD → PMX intermediate followed by `mmd-gltf`, or a PMD-aware converter). Preserve the actual skinned skeleton/weights, original bone identities, materials/textures, supported morphs, MMD physics rigid bodies/joints and the relevant glTF MMD-specific extensions. No PMD/PMX runtime loading.
- [ ] Load the converted glTF/GLB with `GLTFLoader` and the relevant MMD extension plugins (toon/outline, physics, and other extensions appropriate for this source). Do not use a static-mesh-only export.
- [ ] Tune and test SOMA → **Animasa-specific** bone mapping, rest-pose axes, proportions, root/center control, legs and toes. Make movement driven by live MotionBricks-generated SOMA poses (walk/run/turn/stop), not prerecorded VMD.
- [ ] Enable actual MMD hair/skirt/secondary-body physics synchronized to MotionBricks. Assess leg/toe IK **on vs. off** for this specific PMD rig and document the evidence; leave other required IK/append constraints active where applicable. Avoid competing FK/IK or duplicate physics stepping.
- [ ] Update character selection so users can explicitly choose **Animasa Miku**, while retaining the existing native SOMA demo. Preserve physics toggle, loading/error states, keyboard movement, WebGPU inference, and resource cleanup on switching.
- [ ] Update tests, documentation, attribution, asset provenance, conversion instructions, license notices and GitHub Pages static asset packaging/paths. Verify browser appearance, motion and physics on supported WebGPU browsers.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The MMD character shown and named is **verified あにまさ式初音ミク**, not CG-CA Uka or a look-alike.
- [ ] It is converted **offline to a skinned glTF/GLB** with MMD-specific extensions, loaded by a glTF loader + plugins; no direct PMD/PMX loading in the deployed demo.
- [ ] The live MotionBricks model animates Animasa Miku for keyboard-controlled walk/run/turn/stop via retargeting; MMD toon/outline and **visible, physically simulated hair/skirt secondary motion** work.
- [ ] IK choice and Animasa-specific bone mapping are documented and validated; switching to/from SOMA continues to work.
- [ ] Conversion and publication comply with the specific model's rights; **if required public redistribution permission is missing, do not mark this request as implemented merely by keeping Uka**. Clearly report the rights blocker and any safe local-only mode; seek confirmation rather than substituting another character.
- [ ] Tests and Pages build pass, with a published-origin check if the GLB is lawfully distributable.

## Why a follow-up is necessary

PR #10 fulfilled much of the technical integration, but [docs/mmd.md](https://github.com/takahirox/three-motionbricks/blob/main/docs/mmd.md) explicitly documents that the chosen character is **CG-CA Uka**, because authorization for republishing the converted Animasa Miku was not established. That distinction must be preserved and resolved rather than treating the user's explicit character request as interchangeable with any MMD model.
